purpose: Add the accepted 64-edge boundary before owner freeze without changing contract.json or oracle.json.
derivation: Literal expected outputs independently hand-authored before implementation. Each of nodes 16,17,18,19 depends directly on every node 0 through 15; all other nodes are isolated. No dependency points back from these dependents to their requirements.
scope: Informational component qualification only; not heldout, external validation, full replay, whole-system proof or product acceptance. All inherited gates remain binding.

graph_cases.rationale: The edge-limit graph is acyclic and valid. Seed 0 directly affects the four declared dependents; other requirements and isolated nodes are unaffected.
Seed 19 has no declared dependents. Its own requirements and the other three nodes sharing those requirements do not become affected.

retention: Preserve original contract.json, oracle.json, first outputs, failures and all inherited controls unchanged.
